content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIELIT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIELIT Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and the interview is scheduled for 28th September 2026. Candidates should report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: For Mathematics, M.Sc./MA in Mathematics with Ph.D. or NET is required. For English, M.A. in English with Ph.D. or NET is required. Specific marks percentages are also detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions, with one post for Mathematics and one for English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 750 per credit hour, with a monthly ceiling of Rs. 50,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NIELIT Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 700/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 350/- for SC/ST and Women candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for NIELIT recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Ropar, Punjab, with the pincode 140001. The exact venue address will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specific information regarding age relaxation.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job for the post of Guest Faculty. The duration and terms of the contract will be as per the institute's policy.
